from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import sqlite3
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from alembic import command
from alembic.config import Config
from neistra_api.main import create_app
from neistra_api.settings import Settings
from tests.integration.test_archive_roundtrip import build_rich_project
from tests.support.api_client import ApiClient

root = Path('/tmp/neistra158-historical-rich-0014-attempt3')
assert not (root / 'neistra.db').exists(), 'Preserve any prior fixture database'
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
command.upgrade(Config('alembic.ini'), '0014')
app = create_app(Settings(data_dir=root, database_url=f'sqlite:///{root / "neistra.db"}'))
client = ApiClient(app)
project = build_rich_project(client)
reply = client.post(f'/api/v1/projects/{project["id"]}/save', json={'expected_revision':project['revision']})
assert reply.status_code == 200, reply.text
project = reply.json()
changed = client.patch(f'/api/v1/projects/{project["id"]}', json={'expected_revision':project['revision'],'name':'Migration edit'})
assert changed.status_code == 200, changed.text
recovered = client.post(f'/api/v1/projects/{project["id"]}/history/undo',json={'expected_revision':changed.json()['revision']})
assert recovered.status_code == 200, recovered.text
project = recovered.json()
assert project['history']['can_redo'] and project['checkpoint_revision'] > 0
assert project['saved_selections'] and project['measurements'] and project['scenes']
app.state.engine.dispose()
with sqlite3.connect(root/'neistra.db') as connection:
 connection.execute('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)')
 tables=[r[0] for r in connection.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name")]
 counts={t:connection.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM "'+t+'"').fetchone()[0] for t in tables}
 assert 'projects' in counts and 'workspace_presentations' not in counts
files={p.relative_to(root).as_posix():p.read_bytes() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and not p.name.endswith(('-wal','-shm'))}
manifest={'source_tag':'v0.33.0','source_commit':'d8636064263f6221c402665da52a4a1738570845','migration_head':'0014','counts':counts,'project_id':project['id'],'retained_redo':True,'checkpoint_revision':project['checkpoint_revision'],'files':{n:{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'size':len(b)} for n,b in sorted(files.items())}}
out=Path('/datadisk/dev/neistra-worktrees/issue-158-durable-ligand-designation/tests/fixtures/migrations/v2-rich-project-0014.zip')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);assert not out.exists()
with zipfile.ZipFile(out,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
 for n,b in sorted(files.items()):z.writestr(n,b)
 z.writestr('manifest.json',json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
print(out,out.stat().st_size,counts,hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
